_changelog_2026-09-08: enemy.base_health 30.0 -> 25.0 so projectile_damage 25.0 one-shots a full-health enemy; keep edits in THIS file (authoritative) in sync with core_env._DEFAULTS (fallback only - arena.json merges over it).
_notes: Single source of truth for Part II environment parameters, mirroring part1_gridworld/config/training_config.json. core_env.py / phases.py / obs.py should load this from CONFIG_DIR/arena.json once implemented rather than hardcoding module constants (ARENA_WIDTH/ARENA_HEIGHT/DEFAULT_MAX_STEPS are kept as fallbacks). max_steps was reduced from the original 3000 so a 300k-timestep run sees a usable number of episode terminations (see docs/AUDIT_main.md 5.4). phase_curve and curriculum values feed phases.py::difficulty_for_phase (see its docstring for the ramp schedule). num_active_enemies_max is the normalisation divisor for the num_active_enemies_frac observation feature (docs/AUDIT_main.md 7.4). REBALANCE (2026-08-28): enemy speed raised (base 1.6->2.4, gain 0.35->0.55 so a phase-6 enemy at 5.15 is nearly as fast as the player's 6.0), spawn interval shortened (120->90, min 40->30), contact damage 12->10 -- the old tuning let the player escape for free and made corner-camping the optimal learned strategy (0 enemy kills across all tuned_v1/v2 rollouts; see arena/rewards_config.py module docstring). All values are starting points to be tuned during implementation and reported in report section 4.
